patch_description: Reorganizes the search as a compact frontier of scored networks. A single evaluation layer owns LP scoring and incumbent updates; candidate generation is separated from move ranking and archive selection. It seeds from diverse repaired QAOA candidates, then allocates calls to a mix of dual-guided switches, surrogate-ranked switches, and occasional broad exploratory moves. The bounded archive preserves distinct basins without repeatedly rescoring cached networks or spending time on elaborate path relinking.
